title: Slow Cooked Ribs
description:
There are all kinds of rib recipes, such as Jackson Ribs, barbecued ribs, baked ribs, etc. and these: slow-cooked, spice-rubbed ribs.
These are made with a spice rub, then slowly cooked, and eaten with a little sauce on the side.
These take a little longer to bake, but the actual amount of work is very limited, unlike the taste, which is huge!
The basic method is below and a couple of examples are shown.
Slow-Cooked Ribs
ingredients: In a small bowl, stir together all the ingredients.
Prepare the rub and rub it on the meat.
Put the ribs on a rack in a pan for the oven.
directions: Cook for 2 hours, rotating the pans, top to bottom, left to right, maybe every 30 minutes.
Slice the slabs into individual ribs and arrange them attractively on a plate, with a drizzle of sauce and more on the side.
In a medium saucepan, sauté the onion in the oil with a little salt for about 3 minutes.
Add the rest of the ingredients and let the sauce simmer for about 30 minutes.
Let it cool somewhat before serving.
The sauce will keep for about a week in the refrigerator.
